shared.modelCostRule: Pause any tactic whose cash plus model cost exceeds 20% of expected contribution margin.

businesses.name: BenchPilot
businesses.category: Local desktop tools for small hardware companies
businesses.customer: Small electronics makers shipping ESP32, RP2040, or STM32 products
businesses.promise: Turn manual flashing and test checklists into one repeatable pass/fail workflow.
businesses.firstWorkflow: Firmware flashing, serial-number assignment, serial pass/fail checks, and CSV production records.
businesses.validationGate: Three paid reservations, two paid pilots of at least CAD $750, or one Shop purchase plus one paid pilot.
businesses.initialOffer: Paid pilot: CAD $750-$1,500 for one supported board, one firmware image, and up to five automated checks.
businesses.primaryHumanDecision: Choose the first supported MCU or board family.
researchQueries: batch flashing ESP32 production serial numbers
small electronics production test fixture USB serial
firmware version tracking during device manufacturing
businesses.riskGuard: Support one narrow hardware family first; do not support every programmer, OS, board, or test method.

businesses.name: LedgerClean
businesses.category: Local document and CSV cleanup/import tool
businesses.customer: Bookkeepers and office administrators repeating messy CSV cleanup
businesses.promise: Convert recurring spreadsheet cleanup into a reusable local import workflow.
businesses.firstWorkflow: Column mapping, duplicate detection, validation rules, and import-ready CSV export.
businesses.validationGate: Three paid cleanup-template reservations or one paid pilot of at least CAD $500.
businesses.initialOffer: Paid pilot: CAD $500-$1,000 for one recurring import workflow and one acceptance fixture.
businesses.primaryHumanDecision: Choose one target source/export pair after evidence collection shows the strongest pain.
researchQueries: bookkeeping CSV import duplicate cleanup problem
QuickBooks CSV import column mapping errors
office admin recurring spreadsheet cleanup workflow
businesses.riskGuard: Do not build generic spreadsheet software; pick one repeated import workflow.

businesses.name: ListFlow
businesses.customer: Small online sellers preparing product photos and bulk listings
businesses.promise: Prepare listing images, filenames, and CSV uploads without a manual editing loop.
businesses.firstWorkflow: Image normalization, filename rules, listing CSV checks, and marketplace-ready export.
businesses.validationGate: Three paid reservations or one shop workflow pilot of at least CAD $750.
businesses.initialOffer: Paid pilot: CAD $750-$1,500 for one seller workflow and one export format.
businesses.primaryHumanDecision: Choose one marketplace/export format only after evidence shows current buyer pain.
researchQueries: bulk listing CSV upload rejected product photos
online seller batch photo resize naming workflow
marketplace listing bulk upload image requirements problem
businesses.riskGuard: Marketplace rules vary; version one needs one export format and one buyer type.
